The total is 6 + 3 + 4 = 13.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a benzene ring on the left has two ortho substituents; the upper substituent is connected to a carbonyl carbon that is also bonded to an O and an OH, and the lower substituent is connected to another carbonyl carbon that is bonded to O and NHR; two OH⁻ species are shown separately with arrows. Count by visual components: benzene ring C-C bonds = 6; upper acyl/carboxyl part excluding O-H = ring-C to carbonyl C, C=O, and C-O = 3; lower acyl/amide part excluding N-H = ring-C to carbonyl C, C=O, C-N, and N-R = 4; hydroxide O-H bonds contribute 0 because H bonds are excluded. Add 6 + 3 + 4 = 13.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环，苯环上有两个邻位取代基。上方取代基连接到一个羰基碳，该羰基碳右侧为 C=O，向上还连接一个带 H 的 O。下方取代基连接到另一个羰基碳，该羰基碳向下为 C=O，向右连接 NHR。图中还画有两个分离的 OH⁻，并带有反应箭头。推理：按题意忽略箭头，并排除所有涉及氢的键。苯环中的 C-C 键计 6 个；上方羧基/酰基部分中，不计 O-H，计 ring-C 到羰基 C、C=O、C-O，共 3 个；下方酰胺部分中，不计 N-H，计 ring-C 到羰基 C、C=O、C-N、N-R，共 4 个；两个 OH⁻ 只有 O-H 键，因涉及氢不计。总数为 6 + 3 + 4 = 13。
